theme: Xử lý khi khách từ chối

vocab.example: I tried to soften the blow when I gave her the news.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đã cố làm giảm nhẹ cú sốc khi báo tin cho cô ấy.

vocab.example: Let me address a concern you might have about the price.
vocab.example_vi: Để tôi giải quyết mối lo ngại của bạn về giá cả.

vocab.example: We usually get some pushback before customers agree to the deal.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi thường gặp phản đối trước khi khách hàng đồng ý với thỏa thuận.

vocab.example: Would you reconsider if we offered a shorter contract?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có cân nhắc lại nếu chúng tôi đề nghị hợp đồng ngắn hơn không?

vocab.example: The client said our product was just not the right fit right now.
vocab.example_vi: Khách hàng nói sản phẩm của chúng tôi hiện không phù hợp.

vocab.example: Even after a no, I always try to keep the door open.
vocab.example_vi: Ngay cả sau khi bị từ chối, tôi luôn cố gắng để ngỏ cơ hội.

vocab.example: I respect the decision, even though I'm a little disappointed.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi tôn trọng quyết định đó, dù có hơi thất vọng.

vocab.example: I'll follow up later next quarter to check in.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi sẽ liên hệ lại vào quý sau để hỏi thăm.

listening.title: Khi khách hàng từ chối đề nghị

lines.speaker: Duy (sales rep)
lines.text: Hi Trang, thanks for letting me know. I want to soften the blow a little — I know this wasn't an easy decision.

lines.speaker: Trang (client)
lines.text: Thanks Duy. Honestly, the price is just too high for our budget right now.

lines.speaker: Duy (sales rep)
lines.text: I understand. Let me address a concern — the price actually includes free onboarding support.

lines.speaker: Trang (client)
lines.text: I see, but I think it's just not the right fit for us this quarter.

lines.speaker: Duy (sales rep)
lines.text: That's fair, I respect the decision. Can I ask what would need to change?

lines.speaker: Trang (client)
lines.text: Maybe if the contract term was shorter, we could reconsider.

lines.speaker: Duy (sales rep)
lines.text: Got it. I'd like to keep the door open in case things change.

lines.speaker: Trang (client)
lines.text: Sure, I appreciate that you're not pushing too hard.

lines.speaker: Duy (sales rep)
lines.text: No worries, some pushback is completely normal in sales.

lines.speaker: Duy (sales rep)
lines.text: I'll follow up later next quarter to check in.

lines.speaker: Trang (client)
lines.text: Sounds good, talk to you then, Duy.

questions.q: Why does Trang decide not to move forward?
options: The price is too high for their budget

questions.q: What does Duy offer to address Trang's concern?

shadowing: I want to soften the blow — I know this wasn't easy.
Let me address a concern about the pricing for your team.
I think it's just not the right fit for us right now.
I'd like to keep the door open in case things change.
Some pushback is completely normal, so don't worry about it.
